newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Fewer people visit New Zealand in June qtr - SNZ.
newsitem.headline: Fewer people visit New Zealand in June qtr - SNZ.

text.p: The number of overseas visitors to New Zealand in the June quarter was down three percent on the year ago quarter, Statistics New Zealand said on Monday.
Overseas visitors totalled 283,600 during the quarter, down 10,000 on the June 1996 quarter total.
Visitors from Australia, the largest source country, fell five percent against the same period in 1996, to 89,700.
Asia, the second largest source region for overseas visitors, recorded a fall of three percent to 94,700 visitors.
During the June quarter there was a net loss to New Zealand of 2,000 permanent and long-term migrants compared with a net gain of 2,180 in the same period last year.

The number of New Zealand residents making short visits overseas in the June 1997 quarter rose one percent against the year ago quarter. That compared to a 19 percent rise between the June quarters of 1995 and 1996.
